name: screw-tool
description: 打螺丝核玩工具（单文件离线版）

scripts.test:ae: node test/ae-export.mjs && node test/ae-mock.mjs /workspace/screw_ae_sample.zip && node test/ae-composite.mjs
scripts.test:ae:classic: AE_THEME=classic AE_ZIP=/workspace/screw_ae_sample_classic.zip AE_OUT=/tmp/screw_ae_classic node test/ae-export.mjs && node test/ae-mock.mjs /workspace/screw_ae_sample_classic.zip && CHECK_OUT=screenshots/ae_export_check_classic.jpg node test/ae-composite.mjs /workspace/screw_ae_sample_classic.zip /tmp/screw_ae_classic/snaps
scripts.test:3d:classic: E3D=1 AE_THEME=classic AE_ZIP=/tmp/screw_ae_classic_3d.zip E3D_ZIP=/workspace/screw_3d_sample_classic.zip AE_OUT=/tmp/screw_ae_classic3d node test/ae-export.mjs && SNAP=/tmp/screw_ae_classic3d/snaps E3D_ZIP=/workspace/screw_3d_sample_classic.zip E3D_DIR=/tmp/screw_e3d_classic E3D_CMP=$PWD/screenshots/export3d_blender_compare_classic.jpg bash test/export3d-blender.sh
